description: Create design. Create a mail design from custom HTML, or save a prompt as a draft. Custom HTML with one outer div declaring inline width and height: 4x6 = 1800 x 1200, 6x9 = 2700 x 1800, 6x11 = 3300 x 1800 CSS pixels. Use inline styles only. Stylesheets, scripts, SVG and embedded documents are unsupported. Put spacing, borders and layout inside the outer div; root transforms, margins and padding are unsupported. Each side must be nonempty and at most 2 MB. Invalid or ambiguous canvases return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR before saving. The API parses and sanitizes HTML without running a browser. Publishing requires complete validated front and back HTML. Prompt-only designs cannot be auto-published. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

auto_publish.description: Publish only when both sides have complete validated HTML; prompt-only designs remain drafts
